prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Convert this layout guide to a warm casual fountain-pen and watercolor travel notebook map component of ordinary Beijing Xinhua Street housing. INPUT is binding layout and framing: retain the exact canvas, scale, building ground positions, orientations, relative widths and heights. Keep all empty margins. Not an architectural presentation. Final on-map whole compound only 200 pixels wide: very broad uneven pen marks, simplified facade bands, few windows, no tiny panes or roof clutter. Warm restrained colors, paper tooth within pigment. Transparent exterior, minimal pale yard wash, at most a few loose green dabs. NO roads, people, text, street labels, cars, solid platform, border or drop shadow. Each footprint remains separable; do not invent more buildings or rearrange them. THREE tall compact modern apartment towers and ONE long fairly tall modern elevator slab at the bottom. The slab is roughly 70% tower height, not a three-story walkup. Modern cream/gray concrete walls with broad muted blue-gray balcony bands. Simple flat roofs, no red brick. No counting floors literally: a few broad facade marks suggest tall housing.
